summary: The lint accepts bindings, prelude substrings, or annotations after/away from the first executable $WT use.
Four-backtick, extended-info-string, and braced-operator $WT fences can escape the bundled scanner.
Unreadable or missing scan inputs can still yield an empty error list and workflow_lint PASS.
Deleting the canonical Step 10d launcher binding/guard leaves every committed test green.
Lint coverage predicate is order/context-insensitive — real recall edge; downgraded: plan v3 explicitly declined a pattern-ordering form.
evidence: workflow_lint.py:12958-12974 _wt_fence_is_covered (verified: WT= match on any line; non-comment 'eval'+'--guard prelude' substring; wt-binding: substring anywhere). Plan v3 U4: 'keeps U5's PASS conditions to the two simple forms ... instead of adding a third pattern-ordering form to the lint'; U5 registers exactly forms (a)/(b). Codex's own review: 'No current live fence was found with an unsafe first executable $WT use.' Mechanizable follow-up hardening (first-executable-use ordering + leading-comment-stanza token).
